summary:
**Market summary: session of 2026-10-28**

U.S. equities finished higher in the prior session. SPY rose 0.34%, QQQ 0.60%, IWM 0.40%, and DIA 0.27%. Technology led (XLK +0.80%), while communication services (XLC -0.42%) and utilities (XLU -0.84%) lagged. Health care (XLV +0.30%) and financials (XLF +0.45%) posted modest gains. Long Treasuries (TLT) fell 0.78%, the dollar ETF (UUP) slipped 0.21%, and oil (USO) rose 1.64%. Gold (GLD) gained 0.33%.

The day-of-publication movers reflect intraday trading on 2026-10-29 and are not closing figures. Reported moves include Alphabet, down about 13% after weak Q3 results, and gains in Porch, Teladoc, and Crocs. Microsoft was the most-mentioned ticker in news, including a reported plan for at least $25 billion in bonds, its first debt sale since 2017. Merck, Hershey, and Caterpillar also drew coverage tied to earnings and outlook commentary.
